No.S.Legis.1(31)/2002, dated

1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh General

(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 19-A in the West Pakistan Act IV of 1956

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 2002
SINDH GENERAL
CLAUSES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh General Clauses Act, 1956
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th September, 2002]
No.S.Legis.1(31)/2002, dated
18-9-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information.--
2. Insertion of new section
19-A in the West Pakistan Act IV of 1956.--In the Sindh General Clauses
Act, 1956, after section 19, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:-
" 19-A.
Rules and Orders, etc. to be published.--All rules, notifications,
orders/regulations and circulars having the effect of law made or issued under
any enactment shall be published in the official. Gazette. "
